paite: Huchi in Khrist in taksa a athuak ziak in nou leng huchibang lungsim in kivan un; sa a thuak khinsa in gilou atawpsanta hi.
heading: Pathian A Ding A Hinna

paite: Huchi in tunung sa a om lai teng mihing duhgawlna lam bang a om lou in, Pathian deihlam in a-omta hi.
Zentelte ut lam hihna, huknate, tak taksa utnate, uain hainate, zu khamnate, milim biakna kihhuaitakte tuma lam a hihsa teng i na zang khin ngal a.
Huai a amau nuambawl luatna bang a noute'n tu a na bawl sam louh uh lamdang asa ua, nou ahon gense nak uhi.
Amau mihing leh misite ngaihtuah ding a mansa kiang ah atanchin uh agen ding uhi.
Hiai ziak in ahi, misite kiang a leng tanchinhoih gen a hih, sa a om mihingte bang a ngaihtuah in om mah le uh, kha a bel Pathian bang a ahintheihna ding un.
Himahleh thil tengteng tawpna anaita, huaiziak in na thumtheihna ding un lungsim diktak pu in pilvang un.
Bangdang teng sang in phatuamngaitak in ki-ittuah chiat unla; itna in gilou tampi akhuh zel hi.
Phun lou in kizintun tuah unla;
michih in thilpiak na muh bang zel un, Pathian hehpihna chiteng kemhoihte bang in huaite in nna kisepsaktuah chiat un.

Mi kuapeuh in thu agenleh Pathian thute bang in gen hen; mi kuapeuh in nna asepleh Pathian in hatna apiak bang in sem hen; huchi in Jesu Khrist ziak in thil bangkim ah Pathian pahtawi in a-om thei ding, thupina leh vaihawmna tangtawn in amah a ahi, Amen.
Deihtakte aw, na lak ua ze-etna thupitak hong om, noumau ze-etna ding a na tung ua hong tung, thillamdang na tung ua tung bang in lamdang sa kei un.
heading: Khrist Min A Thuak Hamphatna

paite: Khrist thuaknate thuakpihte na hihdan bang zel un kipak zaw un; huchi in athupina a ahong kilak chiang in noumau leng nuamtak in na kipak thei ding uhi.
Khrist min ziak a tai na hih uleh, na hampha uhi; na tung uah thupina kha leh Pathian kha a-om gige hi.
Himahleh na lak uah kuamah in tualthatmi ahih ziak hiam, midangte thilhih gensakmi ahih ziak hiam in thuak kei hen.
Himahleh, Khristian ahih ziak a athuakleh zum kei hen; huai min pu ahih ziak in Pathian pahtawi zaw hen.
Pathian inkuanpihte ah vai-hawmna pat ahunta hi; huan eite ngei a apan masakleh Pathian tanchinhoih thumangloute tawpna bangchi phet ahi diam aw?
Huan, "Midiktat nangawn hotdam liailiai ahih in, Pathian limsak lou leh migiloute koi ah bang asuak ding ua?"
Huaiziak in Pathian hoihsak bang a thuakte'n thil hoih hih in akhate uh Siampa muanhuaitak kiang ah kemsak hen.
